notes.title: STATUS: CURATED
notes.content:
Plenty of Steam curators have recommended STATUS: INSANE, yet none of them have unrecommended it. Which is a great success! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30437390/1ffc1c9296dcb16af0ca74ff5b9773f74204165f.png

Here are some fine examples:

TechRaptor 

"STATUS: INSANE a bit clunky around the edges, but it's also a fun puzzle game that occasionally wanders into brilliant territory" 

FSGGA 

"This game was pure awesomeness! It had this thing which kept you wanting to return to this game all the time. I would say that this game is worth of every dollar!" 

Pro-G GamingCommunity 

"A fun maze puzzle game. The game is very challenging, with many incredibly great levels. Soundtrack is amazing and makes the game more enjoyable. It's one of the best top-down view escaping games!"

Puzzled Adventurers 

"Insanely strange and original puzzle adventure game. Great puzzles with new mechanics added at a steady pace to keep it fresh and a completely insane story."

_Gamerworld_ 

"This is a game from a finnish developer, where you play as Igor, a patient of some sort. The game is nothing but crazy, there are random notes and even finglish! I found this really fun to play! 8/10"

Kettu Gaming 

"A very fun game where the objective is to escape a mental asylum. Combines puzzle and strategy elements and has collectible items for extra challenge. Highly recommended." 

Here is the full list of STATUS: INSANE curations: http://store.steampowered.com/curators/curatorsreviewing/?appid=654430


Thank you for your interest. Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

Yours Sincerely,
Team Frostbullet
